summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad transforms without running any code or committing. Changes: monai/transforms/utility/array.py gains Lambda (callable assertion with "func must be callable", stores func, returns func(img)). monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py gains Callable and Lambda imports, the Lambdad class (MapTransform base for keys, internal Lambda(func), shallow dict copy, per-key application), and the LambdaD/LambdaDict alias line appended after ConcatItemsD. docs/source/transforms.rst gains a Lambda entry before SplitChannel and a Lambdad entry after ConcatItemsd. New tests: tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py with identity and slicing cases on NumpyImageTestCase2D. Not run: tests, flake8, black. Not covered by tests: non-callable AssertionError, empty-keys ValueError, and iterable-callable behavior.
